metadata.description: ryul99's AI tools for Codex and Claude Code

plugins.name: english-lecturer
plugins.description: English lecturer hook - corrects and teaches English from your prompts

plugins.name: english-lecturer-mod
plugins.description: Experimental Claude Code mod version of english-lecturer that teaches in the background and shows the lesson above the prompt

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: LLM Council - get answers from multiple Claude models, have them evaluate each other anonymously, and synthesize the best response

plugins.name: okf-wiki
plugins.description: Inspect, author, validate, and safely refactor Open Knowledge Format wikis with the okf CLI

plugins.name: okf-wiki-handoff
plugins.description: Keep a per-session OKF handoff note current and bring it back, with recallable archived originals, after context compaction

plugins.name: okf-wiki-handoff-mod
plugins.description: Experimental Claude Code mod with Codex-style context management: a kept OKF handoff note, reminders before the context runs out, and fresh context windows that hold only the note

plugins.name: tips-korean
plugins.description: A growing collection of lazily loaded tips for Korean users, the Korean language, and Korea-related contexts

plugins.name: tips-engineering
